name: Friedrich Ebert Foundation: Scholarship for International Doctoral Students
summary: The FES scholarship is intended to provide doctoral candidates with both financial and non-material support throughout their doctoral research. Scholarship holders should be able to concentrate on their doctorate without financial worries
